name: Example project sounds
description: Example sound pack: a wooden bonk on the head + a wobbling spring, and a rising xylophone run.

wooden-bonk.label: Head bonk “BONK—boing”
wooden-bonk.use: Example: a bonk on the head — a wooden “tok”, then a short spring wobble; fits a step with a bonk action.

rising-xylo.label: Rising xylophone “ting-ting-ting-ting”
rising-xylo.use: Example: a rising xylophone run — cheerful, climbing, a bright idea (ACCENT sound: at most one per step).
